title: Dependency Upgrade Rationale — agent rationale input
description: The judgement half of a dependency-upgrade fix report. Written by the agent to .github/.pipeline-context/dependency-upgrader/<issue_id>.rationale.json after drafting the version-bump patch at .github/.pipeline-context/dependency-upgrader/<issue_id>.patch.diff and before running scripts/apply-version-bump.js. Consumed by scripts/render-fix-report.js, which merges it with the script-generated verification record. Describes the diff; it is not the diff itself.

issue_id.description: Must match the fix plan's issue id, e.g. ISSUE-004.

summary.description: 2-4 sentences: which dependency was bumped, from which version to which, and why that target version is the minimum that remediates the advisory — not a restatement of the plan's approach.

files_changed.description: Every file touched by the patch, in the order they appear in the diff. Usually just the one pom.xml.

change.description: One sentence: what changed in this file specifically, e.g. the exact <version> bump.

matches_plan.description: True if the diff bumps exactly the coordinate/version the fix plan named. False if the real pom.xml required deviating from the plan (e.g. the version was managed differently than assumed).

deviations.description: Required (non-empty) when matches_plan is false: exactly what differs from the plan and why.

residual_risk.description: What this diff does not address — e.g. other services or dependencies with their own outdated-version issues, or downstream behavior changes the target version might introduce beyond the CVE fix itself.

open_questions.description: Anything left unresolved. Use this instead of guessing.
